description: List low-hold markets: the best price on each side of one market at two bookmakers, where the two together carry almost no margin (the hold, in percent; 0 is break-even). Useful to find the tightest markets; a low hold is not an arbitrage. Australian bookmakers only by default. Needs Pro or the free Pro trial; 10 credits a page of up to 100 (at most 3 pages).

league_id.description: Only this league, for example nba, nfl, afl or nrl. Leave it out for every league.

markets.description: Optional comma separated market keys, at most 20, for example winner,handicap or player_points_over_under

max_hold_pct.description: Only markets whose combined margin is at most this percent, for example 1

region.description: Keep entries whose every price is at a bookmaker in this region. Default au (Australian bookmakers). Use all for every bookmaker.

name: find_low_holds
title: Find low-hold markets
